name: How do I maintain my painted garage floor?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain my painted garage floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining a painted garage floor helps extend its lifespan and appearance. Regularly sweep or vacuum to remove dirt and debris. For spills, wipe them up immediately with a cloth. For general cleaning, use a mild, pH-neutral cleaner and a mop or soft brush; avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive scrubbers, as these can damage the coating. For epoxy floors, occasional reapplication of a clear topcoat can further enhance protection and gloss.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain a painted garage floor by regularly sweeping, cleaning spills promptly, and using a mild, pH-neutral cleaner with a mop or soft brush.
